summary: This filing is a routine Form 6-K submitted by Caledonia Mining Corporation Plc, a foreign private issuer, disclosing a PCA shareholding notification. It reports that Fremiro Investments, closely associated with Chairman July Ndlovu, sold 20,000 depositary interests at $17.19 per share on May 18, 2026, reducing his beneficial interest. The transaction is a routine insider sale, not a special situation. No strategic review, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or other categorized event is present. The filing merely fulfills periodic disclosure obligations for insider dealings.
